heading: Use of United States mails
lead: The Commission may use the United States mails in the same manner and upon the same conditions as other departments and agencies of the United States.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective Dec. 16, 1967, see section 220(a)(1) of Pub. L. 90–206, set out as a note under section 3110 of Title 5, Government Organization and Employees.
